- Citation and DOI: Joel, S., Teper, R., & MacDonald, G. (2014). People overestimate their
  willingness to reject potential romantic partners by overlooking their concern for other
  people. *Psychological Science, 25*(12), 2233–2240.
  <https://doi.org/10.1177/0956797614552828>
- Data/materials repository URL: <https://osf.io/873fp/> (the PS3 folder `ps3/Group A/Choice 1`
  supplied the Study 1 data file used here)
- Part A (known case) or Part B (a classmate's project paper): Part A
- Part B only: not applicable

## Target outcomes

Taken from the Study 1 results section, as quoted in the folder's `reproducibilityReport.Rmd`.

| # | Target outcome (quoted) | Paper value(s) |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | "Only 10 of the 61 participants in the hypothetical condition chose to exchange contact information with the unattractive potential date (16%)." | 10 / 61 (16%) |
| 2 | "26 of the 71 participants in the real condition chose to exchange contact information (37%)." | 26 / 71 (37%) |
| 3 | "A chi-square test of independence indicated that participants were significantly less likely to reject the unattractive potential date in the real condition compared with the hypothetical condition, X^2(1, N = 132) = 6.77, p = .009." | χ²(1, N = 132) = 6.77, p = .009 |

## Reproduction

The code below is the agent's, copied unchanged from its filled-in
`reproducibilityReport.Rmd`. Only the data path changed, to point at this repo's copy of the data.

```{r}
#| label: setup
library(tidyverse)
library(knitr)
library(haven)
```

```{r}
#| label: load
d <- read_sav("data/Empathy Gap Study 1 data.sav")
```

```{r}
#| label: preprocess
# The file already contains the final analytic sample (N = 132); the 18 exclusions
# described in the article (15 suspicious, 3 not single) were applied before sharing.
nrow(d)

d_tidy <- d %>%
  select(ID, condition, exchangeinfo) %>%
  mutate(condition = as_factor(condition),        # 0 = hypothetical, 1 = real
         exchangeinfo = as_factor(exchangeinfo))  # 1 = yes, 2 = no

d_tidy %>% count(condition, exchangeinfo)
# No missing values on either variable
sum(is.na(d_tidy$condition)); sum(is.na(d_tidy$exchangeinfo))
```

```{r}
#| label: analysis
desc <- d_tidy %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(n = n(),
            n_exchange = sum(exchangeinfo == "yes"),
            pct_exchange = round(100 * mean(exchangeinfo == "yes")))
kable(desc, col.names = c("Condition", "N", "Exchanged info", "% exchanged"))

tab <- table(d_tidy$condition, d_tidy$exchangeinfo)
tab
chi <- chisq.test(tab, correct = FALSE)
chi

tibble(statistic = "X^2", df = chi$parameter, N = sum(tab),
       value = round(chi$statistic, 2), p = round(chi$p.value, 3)) %>%
  kable()
```

|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 10 / 61 (16%) | 10 / 61 (16%) | exact | N/A |
| 2 | 26 / 71 (37%) | 26 / 71 (37%) | exact | N/A |
| 3 | χ²(1, N = 132) = 6.77, p = .009 | χ²(1, N = 132) = 6.77, p = .009 | exact | N/A |

Agent's own claim about success, and whether it was right: the agent wrote, "Yes. All target values reproduced exactly." Yes, the agent was right.
